info.title: Terra Pots Ceramics — Agent API (demo)
info.description: Demo only. Hand-thrown stoneware mugs and plates, made in Jingdezhen. No real orders are taken. Agent-first storefront at https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/terra-pots/ Paths in this document are absolute from the host root, e.g. /shops/terra-pots/llms.txt.

post.summary: MCP Streamable HTTP (demo: documented, not live on GitHub Pages)
post.description: In production this is POST /shops/terra-pots/mcp, Streamable HTTP, tools: list_products, get_product, create_order (mock), get_order. GitHub Pages is static-only, so this demo documents the endpoint in mcp.json instead of serving a live MCP server. See README.md / DISCOVERY.md.
